language: JavaScript (Node.js 20+ / 原生浏览器 ES modules)

workflow_checks.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import {inspect,repair} from "./server/repair/session.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/audio/demo.mjs"; const sample=demo(); const a=inspect(sample); if(a.channels!==2||a.rate!==16000||a.frames!==48000)process.exit(1); console.log(a.frames);'

node --input-type=module -e 'import {inspect,repair} from "./server/repair/session.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/audio/demo.mjs"; const sample=demo(); const a=inspect({...sample,size:1024}); if(a.spectrum.values[0].length!==513||a.spectrum.binHz!==15.625)process.exit(1); console.log(a.spectrum.binHz);'

node --input-type=module -e 'import {inspect,repair} from "./server/repair/session.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/audio/demo.mjs"; const sample=demo(); const a=inspect(sample); const b=repair({...sample,regions:[sample.region]}); const k=Math.round(1600/a.spectrum.binHz); if(b.spectrum.values[90][k]>=a.spectrum.values[90][k]-15)process.exit(1); console.log(b.editedWindows);'

node --input-type=module -e 'import {inspect,repair} from "./server/repair/session.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/audio/demo.mjs"; const sample=demo(); const a=repair({...sample,regions:[]}); if(a.wav!==sample.wav||a.editedWindows)process.exit(1); console.log(a.wav.length);'

node --input-type=module -e 'import {inspect,repair} from "./server/repair/session.mjs"; import {demo} from "./server/audio/demo.mjs"; const sample=demo(); const a=repair({...sample,regions:[sample.region]}); const b=inspect(a); if(b.frames!==48000||a.metrics.length!==2||!a.metrics.every(c=>c.differenceRms>0))process.exit(1); console.log(a.metrics);'
